subject: reasoning
question: F, G, H, J, K and L live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. Only three people live between K and G, where K lives below G. H lives on an odd numbered floor and immediately above K. J lives on one of the floors below F and on one of the floors above L. Who lives on floor numbered 4?
solution:
Given: F, G, H, J, K and L live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6.

1) Only three people live between K and G, where K lives below G.

 
• **Case 1:** G is on Floor 5, and K is on Floor 1.
 
• **Case 2:** G is on Floor 6, and K is on Floor 2.

2) H lives on an odd numbered floor and immediately above K.
